title: Whipped Grass-Fed Tallow Cream — Lemongrass & Lavender
body_html:
This whipped grass-fed tallow cream is the all-rounder your skincare shelf has been missing. Pasture-raised beef tallow meets organic lemongrass and lavender — a calming, clarifying blend that works from morning to bedtime. The texture is light enough to absorb quickly and nourishing enough to transform dry, reactive skin over time. Chemical-free. Ancestral. Just what your skin recognizes.

Why whipped grass-fed tallow

Grass-fed beef tallow has a fatty-acid profile that closely mirrors human sebum — stearic, oleic, palmitic, and palmitoleic acids in ratios similar to what healthy skin naturally produces. That biological compatibility is why tallow absorbs without sitting on top of the skin or feeling heavy. Your skin knows what to do with it.

Grass-fed tallow also carries a richer nutritional payload than grain-fed: higher conjugated linoleic acid (CLA), more fat-soluble vitamins A, D, E, and K, and a better omega-3 to omega-6 balance. These are the same nutrients that support barrier function, cellular renewal, and calm — delivered in a form your skin is built to use.

  • Biocompatible lipid profile — closely mirrors the oils your skin already makes
  • Grass-fed vs grain-fed — higher CLA, more fat-soluble vitamins, better omega balance
  • No synthetic emulsifiers needed — tallow is already an emollient by nature
  • Nose-to-tail sourcing — nothing wasted, everything used with intention

The scent

Lemongrass brings a clean, bright herbaceous note — energizing without being sharp, clarifying without being astringent. Lavender follows with its familiar, soft floral calm. Together they create an aromatherapy experience that feels balanced at any hour: fresh enough to start your morning, soothing enough to close your evening. Neither scent dominates; they settle into each other.

Key ingredients

  • Grass-fed beef tallow — the deeply nourishing base; rich in skin-compatible fatty acids and fat-soluble vitamins
  • Organic extra virgin olive oil — adds squalene and oleic acid for extra softening and skin conditioning
  • Organic golden jojoba oil — a liquid wax that mimics sebum and helps the cream absorb smoothly without residue
  • Organic lemongrass essential oil — clarifying, mood-lifting, mildly antibacterial; supports skin clarity
  • Organic lavender essential oil — skin-calming, soothing for sensitivity and mild irritation, promotes relaxation

What it does

  • Repairs the moisture barrier — lipid-rich formula fills in the cracks that cause dryness and flaking
  • Deep, lasting hydration without grease — absorbs fully within minutes; no sticky residue
  • Supports eczema-prone and sensitive skin — no synthetic triggers; ingredients your skin barrier recognizes
  • Calms redness and reactivity — lavender soothes; tallow's fatty acids reduce inflammatory response
  • Nourishes through seasonal dryness — winter, postpartum, hormonal shifts — tallow holds up when other creams fail

How to use

  1. Scoop a pea-sized amount (a little goes a long way) onto clean fingertips.
  2. Warm between your palms for 2–3 seconds until it softens.
  3. Press and massage into face, neck, or body until fully absorbed.
  4. Use morning, evening, or whenever your skin calls for it — this blend is balanced enough for both.

Who it's for

The Lemongrass & Lavender cream is made for moms who want one product that adapts to their day rather than a separate morning and night formula. It's especially well suited for sensitive and eczema-prone skin, postpartum skin adjustments, and anyone who finds citrus-only products too stimulating or heavier night creams too much for daily use. If you've been searching for a calm, clean everyday moisturizer with ancestral roots, this is your jar.

Free from

No seed oils • No parabens • No sulfates • No synthetic fragrance • No PEGs • No phthalates

Our sourcing story

Our tallow comes from pasture-raised, grass-fed cattle — animals that live on open land and graze as nature intended. We use tallow as part of a nose-to-tail philosophy: utilizing what has already been raised rather than letting nourishing ingredients go to waste. This is the fat our grandmothers and great-grandmothers applied to their skin long before petroleum-based moisturizers existed. Leaf & Bird is bringing it back, paired with organic essential oils and nothing else.

Size & specs

2 oz (56g) · Made in USA · 100% Organic Oils · Store in a cool location away from direct sunlight.

Full ingredient list

Grass-Fed Beef Tallow, Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Organic Golden Jojoba Oil, Organic Lemongrass Essential Oil, Organic Lavender Essential Oil

Suggested use: Apply a small amount to fingertips and massage into skin. Fully absorbs after a few minutes. Safe for all ages and skin types. A little goes a long way.

Warning: For external use only. Avoid direct contact with eyes. Discontinue use if irritation occurs. Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

faq_json.question: What does this cream smell like?
faq_json.answer: The Leaf & Bird Lemongrass & Lavender tallow cream has a balanced herbal-floral scent. Organic lemongrass gives it a clean, bright, slightly citrusy note; organic lavender adds a familiar soft calm. The combined scent is gentle and fades within about 20 minutes of application — it's aromatherapy while you apply, not a perfume that lingers all day.

faq_json.question: Is this cream safe for eczema-prone skin?
faq_json.answer: Yes. Leaf & Bird's whipped tallow cream contains no synthetic fragrance, no seed oils, no sulfates, and no parabens — the ingredient categories most commonly associated with eczema flares. Grass-fed tallow's lipid profile closely mirrors human sebum, making it one of the most biocompatible moisturizers available. Lavender essential oil has documented skin-calming properties. As with any new product, a small patch test is always wise before full application.

faq_json.question: How long does one jar last?
faq_json.answer: A 2 oz jar typically lasts 6–10 weeks with daily facial use, longer if you're using it mainly as a spot moisturizer. Tallow is highly concentrated — a pea-sized amount warms and spreads easily. If you're using it head-to-toe on a larger body area, expect closer to 3–4 weeks per jar.

faq_json.question: Is this safe to use during pregnancy?
faq_json.answer: The formula contains only grass-fed beef tallow, organic olive oil, organic jojoba oil, organic lemongrass essential oil, and organic lavender essential oil — no retinoids, no salicylic acid, no parabens, and no synthetic fragrance. However, please consult your healthcare provider or OB/GYN before adding any new skincare product during pregnancy or breastfeeding, as individual sensitivities vary. This is general information, not medical advice.

faq_json.question: Can I use this on my baby?
faq_json.answer: Many parents use whipped tallow cream on babies and young children, and the simple, clean ingredient list makes Leaf & Bird's formula a reasonable option. That said, we recommend performing a small patch test on your baby's inner arm first and observing for 24 hours, as even organic essential oils can occasionally cause sensitivity in very young skin. Consult your pediatrician if you have any concerns. This is not medical advice.

faq_json.question: What's the difference between grass-fed and grain-fed tallow?
faq_json.answer: Grass-fed tallow contains higher levels of conjugated linoleic acid (CLA), more fat-soluble vitamins A, D, E, and K, and a healthier omega-3 to omega-6 ratio compared to grain-fed tallow. These differences matter for skin: CLA supports barrier function, fat-soluble vitamins support cellular renewal and protection, and a better omega balance reduces the pro-inflammatory load that grain-fed fats can contribute. We use only pasture-raised, grass-fed sources.

faq_json.question: How much cream should I use per application?
faq_json.answer: Start with a pea-sized amount — about the size of a green pea — for full facial coverage. Warm it between your fingers for a few seconds and it will soften enough to spread evenly. Tallow is richly concentrated, so using more than you need won't improve results and will use up your jar faster. For dry patches on the body, a small coin-sized amount is usually enough for each area.
